what services do you offer: Mazda Service Seattle - Lee Johnson offers Minor Service (5,000 mile) for $139.95, Major Service (30k/60k/90k/120k miles) for $639.95, and a-la-carte services such as spark plugs, battery, fluid exchanges, filters, alignment, fuel induction, tire rotation, wiper blades, and tire balancing.
what is minor service: Minor Service (5,000 mile) is $139.95 and includes oil change, tire rotation, video inspection, fluid checks, and brake inspection.
what is included in minor service: Minor Service (5,000 mile) includes oil change, tire rotation, video inspection, fluid checks, and brake inspection. Price: $139.95.
how much is a 5000 mile service: The 5,000 mile Minor Service is $139.95 and includes oil change, tire rotation, video inspection, fluid checks, and brake inspection.
what is major service: Major Service (30k/60k/90k/120k miles) is $639.95 and includes oil change, tire rotation, brake fluid exchange, cooling system exchange, cabin and engine air filter replacement, battery test, and video inspection.
what is included in major service: Major Service (30k/60k/90k/120k miles) includes oil change, tire rotation, brake fluid exchange, cooling system exchange, cabin/engine air filter replacement, battery test, and video inspection. Price: $639.95.
how much is a 30000 mile service: The 30,000 mile Major Service is $639.95. The same Major Service package also applies at 60k, 90k, and 120k miles.
how much is an oil change: An oil change is included in our Minor Service for $139.95, which also includes tire rotation, video inspection, fluid checks, and brake inspection.
how much is a tire rotation: Tire rotation is $39.95 a-la-carte. It is also included in Minor Service ($139.95) and Major Service ($639.95).
how much is a transmission fluid change: Automatic transmission fluid is $249.95. Manual transmission fluid is $169.95.
how much is differential service: Front/rear differential service is $169.95. Skyactiv differential service is also $169.95.
what a la carte services do you offer: A-la-carte prices: Spark Plugs (4-cyl) $399.95, 12V Battery $299.95, Power Steering Fluid $189.95, Cooling System Fluid $209.95, Brake System Fluid $204.95, Automatic Transmission Fluid $249.95, Manual Transmission Fluid $169.95, Cabin Air Filter $75.95, Engine Air Filter $69.95, Front/Rear Differential Service $169.95, Skyactiv Differential $169.95, Four-wheel alignment $179.95, Fuel Induction Service $369.95, Tire Rotation $39.95, Wiper Blades $35.95, Balance Tires $89.95.
how often should I service my mazda: We recommend Minor Service every 5,000 miles ($139.95). Major Service is recommended at 30k, 60k, 90k, and 120k miles ($639.95).
what is a video inspection: A video inspection is included with Minor Service and Major Service so you can see your vehicle's condition and any recommended work before it is performed.
